title: Luxury oceanfront penthouse with steam room
description: Wake to ocean views and sunset over Desecheo Island. Returning under new management after earning 4.88/5 from 26 reviews on its prior listing, this rare two-level oceanfront luxury penthouse sits directly across the street from Rincón’s town beach and sleeps 6. Unwind on the private covered terrace with steam room and outdoor shower, swim in the shared pool, or work comfortably with strong Wi-Fi. Enjoy a coffee station, whole-home filtered water, a reverse-osmosis tap, and a Berkey filter.The spaceRincón Ocean View is an oceanfront gated condo building directly across the street from Balneario Rincón, the town beach. This rare penthouse spans the building’s top two floors, pairing sweeping ocean, sunset, and Desecheo Island views with room to slow down and settle in.The main level is made for easy days together: a full kitchen, dining area, comfortable living room with TV, laundry, and a small covered ocean-view balcony. The kitchen includes a coffee machine and a thoughtfully layered water-filtration setup—filtered water throughout the apartment, a separate reverse-osmosis drinking-water faucet at the sink, and a Berkey filter for an additional level of filtration.Also on the main level are a queen bedroom with an en suite bathroom and bathtub, plus a second bedroom with two single beds and a full bathroom with bathtub nearby.Upstairs, the king suite feels like a private retreat. It has an en suite bathroom, strong Wi-Fi, and a dedicated desk and chair for comfortable remote work. Step outside to your private covered open-air lounge with generous seating, a TV, outdoor shower, and steam room—an ideal wellness ritual after the beach or a day exploring Rincón.Move between floors by the interior spiral staircase or with the special elevator key provided inside the home. Every bedroom has air conditioning. Linens, toiletries, a Pack ’n Play, and a high chair are provided, making the home comfortable for families. Beach chairs, a beach umbrella, and a cooler are ready for days across the street.Guests also enjoy the building’s shared pool, shared elevator, two included parking spaces, and generator. Walk to the town square, restaurants, and markets, or drive a few minutes to Rincón’s celebrated surf beaches.Guest accessGuests have private use of the entire two-level condo, including the upper terrace, steam room, and outdoor shower. A small section of the roof deck is reserved for owner storage; the stored surfboard is not available for guest use. The pool, elevator, and building common areas are shared. Two on-site parking spaces are included.Other things to noteA few helpful details for a comfortable stay:• Balneario Rincón is an active town beach where locals gather for swimming, classes, music, and events. Depending on conditions, you may hear waves, coquí frogs, or activity from the beach and road.• The upper level is reached by an interior spiral staircase or the building’s shared elevator using a special key. Families are welcome; children should be supervised around the staircase, terrace, and shared pool.• The private terrace is open-air, so temperature and mosquitoes vary with the weather.• Power and water interruptions can occur in Puerto Rico. The building has a generator, but island infrastructure, the elevator, and building systems can still experience interruptions.• The pool, elevator, and common areas are shared with other building residents and guests.

title: Serene oceanfront terrace overlooking SANDY BEACH

images.caption: Enjoy the indoor/outdoor lifestyle that living in PR offers! The terrace is a huge living space that allows you to flow in and out. The ocean breeze makes air conditioning almost unnecessary, but the a/c are brand new and available in every space!
The living room is snug and light filled, seating 4 comfortably but with seats for 8 if you pull up the poofs!

This relaxing space has an internet tv, and is a great spot to cozy up after a long day of snorkeling, swimming & surfing. The Starlink WiFi is strong, and the kitchen island is a great spot to seat two more, allowing work inside with ocean views.
The living room has double doors that flow onto the massive terrace, that overlooks both the pool and ocean just beyond.

The galley kitchen is small but well stocked for nights you don’t walk down for dinner. A coffee maker enhances sunrise, and a full sized fridge allows you to stock up at a nearby grocery store or Sunday farmers market. Note NO oven available
Propane stovetop means you can cook when the power is out.
We’ll have enough coffee to get you through your first glorious morning in paradise.
The galley kitchen shares space well with the living room.
Eating outside year round on the covered patio is a huge perk.
The roomy and private covered terrace overlooks the ocean by day and the ocean provides an excellent dinner soundtrack for your covered outdoor dining room and grill area.
Equipped with a king bed and twin bunkbeds around the corner, this becomes a quiet retreat with the door shut to the living room.
The ceiling fan and new air-conditioning unit helps to cool you down after a fun beach day.
Each bunk has its own light and easily accessible plug to charge up phones or games. It is a narrow space but a perfect spot to tuck one or two kids into.
The fourth bedroom is open to the second bedroom, WITHOUT a door separating the two spaces. It’s perfect for parents who want the kids nearby.
The third bedroom has a view of the ocean, a full closet and a brand new queen mattress. The corner set of windows catch the ocean breezes, making the new a/c unit almost unnecessary.
A fresh space with a huge closet.
This is a crisp well ventilated bathroom that is a short walk between bedroom one and bedroom three.
This freshly remodeled bath is on the pool deck, a short walk outside through the garden to access this relaxing space
Sink/toilet inside, shower is screened from view but open to the pool deck
The outdoor poolside shower boasts amazing views of the pool and the ocean beyond
Palms wave overhead as you shower
This nice half bath closest to bedrooms one/three. It takes the pressure off when people are all getting ready to go out. There is a hairdryer in the unit.
The house overlooks the pool and is 1.5 blocks to the iconic Sandy beach, with expansive 180 degree views from sunrise to sunset.
Shaded poolside tables with seating for 8 allow people to spread out
The large terrace is an oasis from the sun, offering a huge sectional perfect for an afternoon siesta, sunset views over the ocean or whale watching.
The sectional on the covered terrace offers the perfect spot for a nap or a sunset cocktail, or a relaxing reprieve from a passing cloudburst.
The new grill with a side burner is a great addition when you want to cook alfresco with an ocean view.
The terraces wrap around the whole house, providing shade in the bedrooms. In the foreground you see the foot washing area conveniently located off the driveway.
The view as you approach the front door to your unit is breathtaking. With views of palms and planters, the house is surrounded by covered terraces cooled by ocean breezes.
We enjoy rainbows, whales, bird watching and more from our terrace year round.
The patio is over 500 sq ft facing the ocean overlooking the private pool, and a great place to find cover from sun or a passing rain shower.
The view as you approach the front door to your unit is breathtaking. With views of palms and planters, the house is surrounded by covered terraces cooled by ocean breezes.
The poolside bathroom is tucked behind the patterned block
Lush walkway landscaping is maintained by a gardener every other week.
Even the walkway from the parking area to your unit is lush and beautiful!
This is the half gate/tiled walkway you will proceed through on the right to get to the Oceanside front door of your unit.
A carport is available to keep the rain and sun off your car. Our car is parked there too for storage, feel free to park it in.
We try to keep 6 beach chairs in the carport for you to borrow.
Exterior gate, view from the road Calle Colina Linda
A huge private first floor level and pool deck to play and relax in

The house is in a serene setting, with crashing waves and coqui frogs that will soothe you to sleep, with no Puerto Rican chickens nearby. The rooftop and the floor above your unit are not accessible to renters, and are empty.
Tres Terrazas is the house in the foreground on the right. It’s in the nicest section of Rincon, surrounded by quiet estates in a secluded setting that is only 1.5 blocks to the action and the beach.
When standing on Sandy beach, glance up and you’ll see our house peeking back at you :)
A short (but hilly) walk to the iconic Sandy beach!
Exterior gate, view from the road Calle Colina Linda
The saline pool never stinks like chlorine. It goes from 3 to 5 feet deep, and has a great Baja ledge that is 12” deep, just perfect to dip your toes into.
Cool off in our pool perched overlooking the ocean, with a 9” deep baja shelf perfect for catching some rays. You can hear the ocean from the pool!
Pool lounging with the sound of the ocean nearby
The Baja shelf with loungers is the perfect way to stay cool in the sun.
We strive to have games out for use!
We provide fast drying embroidered Turkish beach towels to lighten your packing load.
Sunset from our house, with Desecheo island in the distance.

Sandy beach is an iconic Puerto Rico beach for a reason. Sandy bottomed for swimming, extending to Aguada and beyond to while away the afternoon finding beach treasures. Watch amazing sunsets, with 2 excellent restaurants serving beachside drinks.
Downtown Rincon is quaint and packed with restaurants and great shopping.
We welcome you to our corner of paradise!
The hill down to the beach is a 30 sec drive or a two min walk. Many a flip flop has blown out, but it’s a great interval workout!

description: RELAX at this freshly remodeled, centrally-located PRIVATE house overlooking 180 degree views of Sandy Beach in Rincon. You will have two levels within the otherwise empty house, a stylish perch to enjoy the crashing ocean sounds from sunrise to sunset. Watch surfers & whales while you size up the waves from the terrace, before you walk down to surf or boogie board. If you forget something or want to cool off, it’s just a short 2 block walk up the hill to grab lunch or relax on the large terraceThe spaceYour private unit makes up the lower two levels of the house (including the pool deck/outdoor bathroom) and is surrounded by terraces on all four sides. The rental unit is on the main floor, and the owners unit above you remains empty while you are there. If you’d like a bigger space, the whole house is available as a separate listing to get to 5.5 bedrooms 4.5 baths. The oceanfront terrace is a very large, luxurious covered retreat from with sun or passing showers, holding a huge sectional & the main dining table. There are 3 thoughtfully appointed bedrooms, with a 4th room that has a set of bunk beds attached to a 3rd bedroom, with fresh white linens on the two king and one queen beds and twin bunks. We prefer large beds on vacation, and figured you’d feel the same way. We also tucked in a small bunk room to allow for some overflow sleeping space, with a bunk bed that features individual lights and plugs you can run from the bed. Inside your unit are 1.5 bathrooms, with the second full bath on the pool deck featuring an OUTDOOR shower.The saline pool overlooks the ocean, and boasts a Baja shelf and a gorgeous outdoor shower. Several iconic surf breaks are just a few blocks away, along with beachside restaurants and a sandy bottomed beach 1.5 blocks away that beckons you for some Long Beach walks for exercise or seaglass collecting.Guest accessThis unit includes parking for 3 cars in a gated locked driveway, and a completely separate & private first floor unit surrounded by private gated terraces. You do not have access to the upper two floors unless the whole house is rented by you. We are perched at the top of a steep hill that affords breathtaking views overlooking the pool that is used only by your group.Other things to noteThe second full bath is outside on the pool deck. Inside your unit you have 1.5 bathrooms. We installed a state of the art large solar system and water cistern to help stabilize the intermittent electricity grid and water in PR. If the power goes out we automatically go to solar (amazing) but there are some compromises such as going to one a/c to cool the whole unit (which works very well). If you do need the solar, you’ll still have all lights, plugs, fridge/freezer, water and tv, so you can always have cold beer & hot coffee! The solar is silent compared to the noisy/stinky generators most properties use, make sure to inquire before you book about your power and water back up at other rentals. The pool is cleaned every Friday and the gardener arrives every Tuesday or Wednesday depending on the weather. Neither will interfere with your time there, but note they are our trusted partners and this is how we keep the place nice and fresh for you. There is an outdoor shower off the side of the house so you can wash your feet in whenever you return from the beach.The dining table is located outside on the covered terrace with a view of the ocean, and seats 6. There is a poolside dining nook available as well.

title: Great for families and friends. Peaceful area.
description: Welcome to your perfect island escape! This spacious and comfortable retreat is located on the beautiful west side of PR. Ideal for families or groups of up to 10 guests. With 4 cozy bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and an open-concept living room and full kitchen, there’s plenty of room for everyone to relax and enjoy.Step outside to your private pool and soak up the Caribbean sun, or explore the vibrant local scene just minutes away—beaches, restaurants, bars, and fun-filled attractions await!The spaceOur beautiful home features 4 private bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, designed for comfort, privacy, and relaxation. The property includes a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living room, a spacious pool area, and a marquesina (covered parking/terrace space) for your convenience.Important layout detail:Two of the bedrooms are separate private suites with their own independent entrances. While they are part of the same property, they are not internally connected to the main house or to each other—each has access through a different entrance located in front of the pool area. This setup is perfect for added privacy, whether you’re traveling with family or friends. All rooms are completely private.For your comfort, every room is equipped with air conditioning and a TV. The property also includes internet, fresh towels, and a fully stocked kitchen with everything you need for cooking.For your safety and peace of mind, security cameras are installed outside the property only.Island Note: Since we are located on a tropical island, you may occasionally encounter mosquitoes—we recommend bringing repellent to stay comfortable.Guest accessGuests will have full access to the entire property, including all rooms, the pool area, kitchen, living room, and outdoor spaces.Other things to noteIsland Note: Since we are located on a tropical island, you may occasionally encounter mosquitoes—we recommend bringing repellent to stay comfortable.
